name: com.openglyph.text
description: Open-source (MIT) Unicode text engine for Unity: full RTL/BiDi, HarfBuzz shaping, emoji and extensible markup. Community fork of UniText 1.0 by Light Side LLC.

samples.description: Core features: text formatting, RTL languages, and runtime API
Emoji rendering: flags, ZWJ sequences, skin tones
Alignment, word wrap, and AutoSize features
Markup system: styling, colors, links, lists
Font variety showcase: decorative fonts, icon fonts (Font Awesome), monospace, multilingual support
